pastyco_baker.text: A proper Cornish pasty has beef, potato, swede and onion. Nothing else.
The crimp goes on the side, never the top. Since 2011 only pasties made in Cornwall can use the name.
Pasties were made for tin miners to carry underground. The thick crust kept them warm for hours.

then.text: Already had your pasty! One per customer. The seagulls are watching.

else.text: Take a pasty for later. Eat it on a clifftop, it is the law.
